title: ProofFlowInferenceInput
description: Input schema for ProofFlow freelance deliverable evaluation

client_request.description: Original client request, prompt, or project brief

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable acceptance criteria as a list of strings or bulleted text

deliverable_text.description: Actual deliverable text, code snippet, article, or summary

deliverable_path.description: Optional local file path to deliverable content

image_path.description: Optional local path or URL to visual deliverable screenshot/design

work_category.description: Domain work category (e.g., Websites and software development, Writing and content creation, UI/UX and graphic design)

validation_evidence.description: Objective test output, execution logs, assertion results, or benchmark metrics
